title: HTML Forms: Structure, Labels & Inputs
description: Build a clean, semantic HTML form from scratch and understand why each control exists.
summary: A practical HTML form class with a mini project and automated homework checks.

hints: Start with the form element, then create a label-input pair for every field.
Use type='email' for email and type='submit' for the primary action.
Inspect the browser preview after every small change instead of writing the whole form at once.

tasks.title: Create the main form
tasks.description: Add a form with a visible heading and a short helper paragraph.

tasks.title: Add accessible labels
tasks.description: Create at least three labels and connect each one to an input with a matching id/for pair.

tasks.title: Use correct field types
tasks.description: Include an email field, a password field and a submit control.

tasks.title: Add a focused visual system
tasks.description: Style the form container with spacing and a border radius.
